Hong Kong's AI and Robotics Drive IPO Boom, Financial Chief Notes

Hong Kong's financial chief, Paul Chan, stated the city can play a unique role in developing the robotics industry. This comes as the city prepares for the opening of its first convenience stores operated by humanoid robots developed by a Beijing-based company. The Economic Times reported that AI and robotics are driving an IPO boom in China, with Shein listing in Hong Kong. South China Morning Post also noted that an AI-fueled boom has lifted the global billionaire count, with Hong Kong retaining its top spot in Asia.
